correctness.rationale: The two exact torus complements are correctly extracted from Example 4.2 (including E=1+xy from the fourth homogenized equation). The zero curves have Euler values 0,0,-1,-1 and 0,0,-1,0; their only pairwise intersections are 1+2 and 1+1+1, with no triples. Additivity gives Euler characteristics 5 and 4. Generic Cox logarithmic forms coincide with the generic master-function forms under the source unimodular parametrization; by Huh Theorem 1 for smooth very affine surfaces the generic counts equal these Euler values. The packaged rational Gröbner checker saturates by all excluded divisors and proves full reduced quotient dimensions 5 and 4 at an explicit parameter point.
